# Deployed addresses

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/addresses.js from deployments/<network>.json. Do not edit. -->

⚠️ **Test networks only. SRX is not deployed on any mainnet.** These contracts hold test tokens with no value.
Take contract addresses only from this file or from [syrax.global](https://www.syrax.global), never from a third party.

⚠️ **The testnet contracts listed here were deployed on 7 October 2026, before REG-50, REG-53 and REG-54 and before the 16 October 2026 internal-audit fixes, and they will be redeployed.** They still have the old design (upgradeable proxies, the staking bonus stream, `receiveFees`, `recoverLiquidity`, settable fee limits, a circuit breaker that pauses the token) and none of the 16 October fixes. Do not read their behaviour as the current code's. This list will be regenerated when the fixed code is deployed.
